unlisted_practices: Deep learning MRI reconstruction compared with vendor reconstruction, rated for image quality by expert radiologists
Automated on-scanner pipeline sending raw data to an external high-performance computer for reconstruction and DICOM generation

screen.reason: The paper evaluates an automated deep learning prototype (RANGR and Movienet) integrated into MRI scanners for auto-navigation and image reconstruction, evaluated via radiologist reader scoring on patient scans, but tests model performance rather than a specific deployment guardrail practice.
